change.summary: Economic operators filling grouped, transport, or e-commerce packaging must ensure the empty space ratio does not exceed 50% by 1 January 2030 (or 3 years after implementing acts are adopted, whichever is later). Sales packaging fillers must be minimised by 12 February 2028, with specific rules for certain product types.

obligations.text: Ensure empty space ratio in grouped, transport or e-commerce packaging does not exceed 50%.
obligations.quote: By 1 January 2030 or 3 years from the entry into force of the implementing acts adopted pursuant to paragraph 2, whichever is the latest, economic operators who fill grouped packaging, transport packaging or e-commerce packaging shall ensure that the maximum empty space ratio, expressed as a percentage, is 50 %.

obligations.text: Adopt implementing acts to establish the empty space ratio calculation methodology by 12 February 2028.
obligations.quote: By 12 February 2028, the Commission shall adopt implementing acts to establish the methodology for the calculation of the empty space ratio referred to in paragraph 1.

obligations.text: Reduce empty space in sales packaging to the minimum necessary for functionality by 12 February 2028.
obligations.quote: By 12 February 2028, the economic operators who fill sales packaging shall ensure that empty space is reduced to the minimum necessary for ensuring the packaging functionality, including product protection.

obligations.text: Consider space filled by filling materials as empty space when calculating ratios.
obligations.quote: Space filled by filling materials, such as paper cuttings, air cushions, bubble wraps, sponge fillers, foam fillers, wood wool, polystyrene or Styrofoam chips, shall be considered as empty space.

reasons: You ship furniture and leather goods to multiple EU countries from Germany, so you fill e-commerce packaging for delivery.
You also use sales packaging for your products, which falls under the sales packaging rules.
As a micro or small enterprise, you are still an economic operator who fills packaging, so the empty space limits apply to you.

todos.text: Measure the empty space ratio in your shipping boxes and plan to reduce it to 50% or less
todos.quote: By 1 January 2030 or 3 years from the entry into force of the implementing acts adopted pursuant to paragraph 2, whichever is the latest, economic operators who fill grouped packaging, transport packaging or e-commerce packaging shall ensure that the maximum empty space ratio, expressed as a percentage, is 50 %.

todos.text: Review your product packaging and reduce empty space to the minimum needed for protection
todos.quote: By 12 February 2028, the economic operators who fill sales packaging shall ensure that empty space is reduced to the minimum necessary for ensuring the packaging functionality, including product protection.
